Grants 20|40|50 Ammo Generation stat to #element with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

#swords

var element = <arc/>Arc Weapons

var swords = Swords receive 20|30|35 Ammo Capacity Stat instead (these values are the equivalent of having Hungry Edge, Backup Mag, or Enduring Blade equipped respectively).
